skills.name: handoff-writer
skills.description: Turn a long working session into a HANDOFF.md that a fresh agent can resume from without re-reading the transcript. Use when the user says "write a handoff", "hand off this session", "summarize context for a new chat", "wrap up", or when the context window is nearly full and the work is unfinished.
skills.compatibility: Requires Node.js 18+ for the optional scaffold script; the rest is plain Markdown.

skills.name: skill-evolve
skills.description: Turn a prompt-only skill into a work system: a task map, real checks instead of prose promises, and a feedback loop that survives the next correction. Use when the user asks to improve, harden, refactor, or "self-iterate" an existing SKILL.md, says a skill is unreliable or keeps missing steps, or wants tooling, verification, or regression samples added to a skill.
skills.compatibility: Works on plain files. Needs no runtime; checks run with whatever the skill under repair already requires.
